notes:
Refers to a country's internal governance and political matters, as opposed to foreign affairs (⟦{外交|がいこう}→外交：02627_gaikou⟧). Often encountered in news and political commentary.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {内政|ないせい}⟦{干渉|かんしょう}→干渉：12445_kanshou⟧: interference in domestic affairs
- {内政|ないせい}⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧: domestic issue
- {内政|ないせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{口出|くちだ}しする→口出しする：25233_kuchidashisuru⟧: to meddle in internal affairs
- {内政|ないせい}{不干渉|ふかんしょう}: non-interference in domestic affairs

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{外交|がいこう}→外交：02627_gaikou⟧: foreign affairs, diplomacy — the counterpart to {内政|ないせい}
- ⟦{国内|こくない}→国内：02998_kokunai⟧⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧: domestic politics — a broader, more casual synonym
- ⟦{国政|こくせい}→国政：12131_kokusei⟧: national politics — covers both domestic and foreign aspects
